title: Christmas Dogs Sticker Bundle
author: digitalglai
description:
The Christmas Dogs Sticker Bundle is perfect for your next digital craft project, POD (print on demand) design, mug design, printed artwork display, and more!
What you’ll get:
Ten illustrations / Christmas stickers with PNG and JPG format that are ready to use and may be used for different end products like wall art, stickers, t-shirts, mug, pouches, and other different merch products. You will also receive a sticker sheet in EPS and AI format.
All in high-resolution images!
PNG to be used as clipart and stickers
JPG for prints or iron on transfers
Please ensure that your software can use the above formats files, before the purchase.
*The text font is not included. (only the illustration in the picture)
*Mockups not included and are just for presentation purposes only
